description: Get a single evidence submission for one of your bounties, including its uploaded files and advisory automated-check report. Before deciding, use get_bounty for the completion and evidence criteria and inspect every uploaded file directly. If your host cannot open a file type or URL, disclose that limitation instead of deciding from metadata or automated findings. Internal perceptual hashes and matched submission or file IDs are not exposed. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the evidence submission to retrieve

name: get_submission
